# The note says why the character's strokes are not as many as Unihan's kTotalStrokes counts, or why
# rime-stroke has none of its orders of these kinds; the build fails on a character either is so of
# without one, and on a note with nothing to say why of: a note is no place for a line's history
# (ime-dict-tool charinfo). Kept by hand from here on: a wrong stroke is corrected in place (git keeps
# what it was). The card shows it (CharCard, StrokeShape): ㇤ and ㇥ as ⺄ and ㄣ, which Android's Noto
# commit b8397db3e08e88ebbf8acf92b5cbab1a7e4c1550, 6,939 simplified characters), where it came from it
